column1: SECTION 2: 3-MONTH REVENUE PROJECTION (Conservative - 1 new client every 2 weeks)
- Monthly costs start at $347 (recommended stack) and increase $50/mo for variable costs
- First clients are likely Starter tier as portfolio builds
- Growth/Premium clients acquired as reputation develops
- No client churn assumed in first 3 months
- Revenue recognized in month service begins
SECTION 3: 3-MONTH REVENUE PROJECTION (Moderate - 1 new client per week)
- Active networking and content marketing generates steady pipeline
- Client mix improves as portfolio and testimonials accumulate
- Variable costs increase ~$100/mo as client base grows
- Assumes strong initial outreach and 10% conversion on leads
SECTION 4: 3-MONTH REVENUE PROJECTION (Aggressive - 2 new clients per week)
- Requires significant prior network or marketing investment
- May require subcontractors or additional AI tools at scale
- Client distribution shifts toward higher tiers faster
- Assumes aggressive cold outreach + referral engine running
- Churn risk increases at this pace - budget 5-10% client loss
SECTION 5: YEAR 1 PROJECTIONS - Three Scenarios (Monthly Breakdown)
Scenario A: 4 Steady Clients (Solo Lifestyle Business)
Scenario B: 8 Clients by Month 6 then steady (Solid Small Agency)
Scenario C: 15 Clients by Month 9 then growth (Growth-Focused Agency)
Key Insight: "With just ONE client at the Starter tier ($500/mo) you nearly cover all recommended monthly costs. True profitability begins with client #2."
(Flexibility Premium = 25% markup on agency income for schedule freedom)
